description: Verify a milestone-commit schedule on Hedera mainnet (read-only, via the public mirror node). Decodes the scheduled payment (recipient, amount, 98/2 split), reports signatures, expiry, and whether it was executed or deleted. Returns safe_to_start for the worker, optionally checking the schedule against expected milestone id, worker, and amount. A deleted or unsigned schedule means do not start work.

expected_milestone_id.description: Milestone id you expect in the schedule memo

expected_worker_username.description: Worker username you expect as tip recipient

name: verify_milestone_commit
title: Verify milestone commit
